title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
ingredients: 500 grams large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook linguine until al dente.
Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add garlic and red pepper flakes; cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side until pink.
Pour in white wine and lemon juice; simmer for 2 minutes.
Toss in drained pasta, parsley, and lemon zest. Season with salt and pepper.
